# Set Up

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
})

base_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(
  rprojroot::has_dir("AD_CR_HRS"),
  path = here::here()
)
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "AD_CR_HRS")
ad_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "AD_CR")
data_dir <- file.path(ad_dir, "data", "DNAm_Aplus", "processed")
legacy_dir <- file.path(
  ad_dir, "analysis_results", "only_amyloid_positive_2_stage_approach"
)
pheno_path <- file.path(legacy_dir, "sig_probes", "Phenotypes.csv")
legacy_mrs_path <- file.path(legacy_dir, "mrs", "MCI_MRS_scores.csv")
cogn_path <- file.path(
  base_dir, "DATASET", "ADNI", "Phenotype", "raw",
  "ADSP-PHC_8-2025", "ADSP_PHC_COGN_22Aug2025.csv"
)
beta_path <- file.path(data_dir, "PCA.RDS")
save_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "analysis-results", "ADNI")
cohort_path <- file.path(save_dir, "ADNI_2025_MCI_future_data.rds")
```

# Load Data

```{r load}
input_paths <- c(pheno_path, legacy_mrs_path, cogn_path, beta_path)
missing_paths <- input_paths[!file.exists(input_paths)]
if (length(missing_paths)) {
  stop("Required ADNI input files are missing: ", paste(missing_paths, collapse = ", "))
}

pheno_source <- readr::read_csv(pheno_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
legacy_mrs <- readr::read_csv(legacy_mrs_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
cogn_source <- readr::read_csv(cogn_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
dnam_data <- readRDS(beta_path)
beta_source <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(dnam_data, "dnam")
```

# Select the 2025 MCI Cohort

## Baseline Phenotypes

```{r baseline}
# The 2025 analysis used MCI rows from Phenotypes.csv and matched MRS IDs.
mci_df <- pheno_source %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$PHC_Diagnosis == 2) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    sample = as.character(.data$sample),
    RID = .data$RID,
    PHASE = .data$Phase,
    dnam_date = as.Date(.data$DateDrawn),
    baseline_age = .data$age_at_visit,
    PHC_Age_Biomarker = .data$PHC_Age_Biomarker,
    APOE4 = .data$APOE4,
    Gender = .data$Gender,
    B = .data$B,
    Mono = .data$Mono,
    CD4T = .data$CD4T,
    Neutro = .data$Neutro,
    Eosino = .data$Eosino,
    NK = .data$NK,
    baseline_pTau = .data$PHC_pTau,
    raw_pTau = .data$pTau_RAW,
    Gran = .data$Neutro + .data$Eosino
  )

if (anyNA(mci_df$sample) || anyDuplicated(mci_df$sample) ||
    anyNA(mci_df$RID) || anyDuplicated(mci_df$RID)) {
  stop("The legacy MCI phenotype data must have one sample and one row per RID.")
}
if (anyNA(legacy_mrs$sample_id) || anyDuplicated(legacy_mrs$sample_id)) {
  stop("The legacy MRS file must have one nonmissing row per sample_id.")
}

mci_df <- mci_df %>%
  dplyr::semi_join(
    legacy_mrs %>% dplyr::transmute(sample = as.character(.data$sample_id)),
    by = "sample"
  )
```

## Future Cognition Visits

```{r future_visits}
cogn_df <- cogn_source %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    RID = .data$RID,
    PHASE = .data$PHASE,
    EXAMDATE = as.Date(.data$EXAMDATE),
    PHC_Education = .data$PHC_Education,
    PHC_MEM = .data$PHC_MEM,
    PHC_Age_Cognition = .data$PHC_Age_Cognition,
    PHC_Diagnosis = .data$PHC_Diagnosis,
    PHC_Sex = .data$PHC_Sex
  )

# The original join was on RID only, and excluded the MCI date itself.
longitudinal_df <- cogn_df %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(mci_df, by = "RID", relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$EXAMDATE > .data$dnam_date) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    time = as.numeric(difftime(.data$EXAMDATE, .data$dnam_date, units = "days")) /
      365.25
  )

baseline_mem <- cogn_df %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    mci_df %>% dplyr::select("RID", "dnam_date"),
    by = "RID", relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$EXAMDATE == .data$dnam_date) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(.data$RID, baseline_MEM = .data$PHC_MEM)

if (anyDuplicated(baseline_mem$RID)) {
  stop("Multiple baseline PHC_MEM values were found for a RID.")
}

longitudinal_df <- longitudinal_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    baseline_mem,
    by = "RID", relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

# Only people with an old MRS and at least one future visit entered the
# 2025 model data (mrs_cogn). Keep that cohort for every new weight set.
mci_df <- mci_df %>%
  dplyr::semi_join(longitudinal_df %>% dplyr::distinct(.data$RID), by = "RID")
longitudinal_df <- longitudinal_df %>%
  dplyr::semi_join(mci_df %>% dplyr::select("sample"), by = "sample")

if (!nrow(mci_df) || !nrow(longitudinal_df)) {
  stop("No 2025 MCI samples have both an old MRS and a future cognition visit.")
}
```

# Match DNAm to the Selected Samples

```{r match_dnam}
if (is.null(colnames(beta_source)) || anyDuplicated(colnames(beta_source))) {
  stop("DNAm beta data must have unique sample IDs as column names.")
}

missing_samples <- setdiff(mci_df$sample, colnames(beta_source))
if (length(missing_samples)) {
  stop(
    "Selected 2025 samples missing from PCA.RDS: ",
    paste(missing_samples, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# 07b expects CpGs in rows and samples in columns.
beta_data <- as.matrix(beta_source[, mci_df$sample, drop = FALSE])
stopifnot(identical(colnames(beta_data), mci_df$sample))
```

# Save Data

```{r save}
if (!dir.exists(save_dir)) dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE)

adni_data <- list(
  beta_data = beta_data,
  pheno_df = mci_df,
  longitudinal_df = longitudinal_df
)
saveRDS(adni_data, cohort_path)

data.frame(
  selected_samples = nrow(mci_df),
  selected_RIDs = dplyr::n_distinct(mci_df$RID),
  future_visit_rows = nrow(longitudinal_df),
  saved_to = cohort_path
) %>% knitr::kable()
```
